en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 22.30.
Sanidassanattika, Āsavagocchaka.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not an outflow, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and an outflow, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are three.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not an outflow, there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and not an outflow, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are twenty-one; under object [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not subject to the taints (*anāsava*), there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and subject to the taints by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated. Twenty-one [conditions] for root; twenty-one for predominance (*adhipati*) … pe … twenty-one for non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not subject to the taints, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not subject to the taints by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [conditions] for root … pe … three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not associated with the taints (*āsava*), there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and associated with the taints, by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and dissociated from the taints, there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and dissociated from the taints, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under object condition... [and so forth].
Three ... [and so on] ... twenty-one in non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and neither with taints nor without taints, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and both with taints and subject to taints, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three in root ... [and so on] ... three in non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is visible, impinging, neither with-outflows nor without-outflows, there arises a state that is visible, impinging, both with-outflows and not without-outflows, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: twenty-one;
under object: three ... pe ... under non-disappearance: twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and neither an outflow nor dissociated from outflows, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and both an outflow and associated with outflows, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three [results] under root; ...
pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-manifesting, non-reactive, dissociated from the taints, and not itself a taint, there arises, by way of root condition, a state that is non-manifesting, non-reactive, associated with the taints, and not itself a taint. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ...
pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a state that is visible, impinging, dissociated from the taints, and untainted, there arises a state that is visible, impinging, dissociated from the taints, and tainted, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are twenty-one under root;
twenty-one under predominance … pe … twenty-one under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, dissociated from the taints, and not itself a taint, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, dissociated from the taints, and not itself a taint, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three [results] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
